list.name: publisher
list.label: Publisher
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT publisher FROM ops.dq_results ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT publisher FROM ops.dq_results ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest check per rule
panels.description: Which rules failed in the publisher's most recent data-quality run, and at what rate?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.rule,
       r.severity,
       r.failed_rows,
       r.total_rows,
       ROUND((100.0 * r.failed_rows / NULLIF(r.total_rows, 0))::numeric, 1) AS failed_pct
FROM ops.dq_results r
WHERE r.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND r.dq_run_id = (
    SELECT d.dq_run_id
    FROM ops.dq_results d
    WHERE d.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY d.dq_run_id
    ORDER BY MAX(d.checked_at) DESC, d.dq_run_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY r.severity, r.rule

panels.title: Failed rows by rule
panels.description: How have rule failure counts changed over the selected seven-day time range?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT checked_at AS time,
       rule AS metric,
       failed_rows AS value
FROM ops.dq_results
WHERE publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(checked_at)
ORDER BY checked_at, rule

panels.title: Quarantined rows (latest run)
panels.description: How many quarantine-severity failures were recorded in the latest quality run?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.failed_rows), 0) AS quarantined_rows
FROM ops.dq_results r
WHERE r.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND r.severity = 'quarantine'
  AND r.dq_run_id = (
    SELECT d.dq_run_id
    FROM ops.dq_results d
    WHERE d.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY d.dq_run_id
    ORDER BY MAX(d.checked_at) DESC, d.dq_run_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )

panels.title: Rows with at least one soft flag
panels.description: How many distinct articles in the current published snapshot have at least one soft quality flag?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS flagged_articles
FROM serving.fact_article f
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND f.dq_flag_count > 0

panels.title: DQ runs recorded
panels.description: How many distinct data-quality runs have been recorded for this publisher?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dq_run_id) AS dq_runs
FROM ops.dq_results
WHERE publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
